frame_convention: Frames and damage from T3 Gon bank rows (60fps). Damage scaled to WH 100HP. Move names and inputs from Tekken 3 Prima Official Strategy Guide (Namco, 1998), Gon section.
canon_note: Dorowani is Gon's Western Heart replacement (name locked 2026-10-22). Mud-croc kappa-yokai. Moveset = Gon's Tekken 3 kit translated to Dorowani's croc body: jaw snaps, tail swipes, fire breath. Voice: barks Japanese words, never sentences ('Konnichiwa arigato Ichiban Bankai').

anim_set_lock.FIGHT: every move in this file: moveset moves and combat stances — the combat animation bank
anim_set_lock.SHOW: win poses, intro poses, taunts, cutscene animations — intro/win slots and cutscenes ONLY; tracked in docs/anim/T3-GON-ANIM-20261023.md; must NEVER enter this moveset without the user's explicit approval
anim_set_lock.note: per-move 'set' tags stamp what each pull lane added; the file itself is the FIGHT set

1.name: Snap Bite
1.note: Quick jaw snap. Gon's jab translated to Dorowani's croc bite.

1,2.name: Snap-Claw
1,2.note: Bite into claw swipe. Basic string.

1+2.name: DINO BREATH
1+2.note: SIGNATURE: Fire breath from the mouth. Gon's best move per Prima guide ('if in doubt, use the Dino Breath!'). Long range, knocks down.

b+4.name: Gon with the Wind
b+4.note: SIGNATURE GOOFY: The fart attack. Turns back, blasts wind. ~20% damage per Prima. Very limited range, punishable on whiff.

4,4,4,4,4.name: Tail Spin
4,4,4,4,4.note: 5-hit tail spin string. Prima: RK x5. Each hit 7 dmg.

d/b+3,3.name: Clean Sweep
d/b+3,3.note: Low sweep into tail. Prima: d/b+LK, LK.

f,f+3+4.name: Head Butt
f,f+3+4.note: While running headbutt. Prima: While running f+LK+RK. T3 row 213 (f+1+2 branch, dmg 27).

FC+d/b+3+4.name: Oopsie-Daisy
FC+d/b+3+4.note: From crouch, rolling attack. Prima: FC, d/b+LK+RK.

f,d/b+1+2.name: Armadillo Attack
f,d/b+1+2.note: Rolling shell attack. Prima: f, d/b+LP+RP. Uses Dorowani's shell!

u+1.name: Lift-Off
u+1.note: Jumping bite. Prima: u+LP. Leaps to head height.

1+3.name: Bite Me
1+3.note: THROW: Grabs with mouth (Gon's tiny arms can't reach, so he uses his mouth per Prima). Prima: LP+LK.

2+4.name: Death Roll
2+4.note: THROW: Crocodile death roll. Grabs and spins. Prima: RP+RK.

qcf+1+2.name: MEGA DINO BREATH
qcf+1+2.note: SUPER: Massive fire breath. Motion input special. Dorowani's ultimate.

SS+2.name: Sidestep Snap
SS+2.note: Sidestep into claw. Gon is tricky to follow per Prima.
